content:
The **Red Rocket** is an unmarked location within Flatwoods, situated in The Forest region of Appalachia.

A small Red Rocket gas station within the pre-War town.

The gas station is situated on the south side of town. The building is filled with detritus along with random loot. It has a Stash Box within it and a Tinker's Workbench on the outside/rear. On the roof, the word "HELP" is spelled out using wooden planks. A small campsite is located here, as well as the Skeleton of an unfortunate Nukashine user.

The roof is a possible location to wake up after passing out from drinking Nukashine. It is not accessible without the Marsupial mutation or a Jet Pack.

The Red Rocket in Flatwoods appears in *Fallout 76*.
